tasks.message: Design a new Asana-triggered agent that answers questions about a task's subtasks: name it, and give me the trigger model, request contract, tools, state boundaries and the deploy-time inputs I must collect. Design only.

must_include: DynamoDB chat state with a unique keyPrefix
AgentCore Memory kept separate from Chat SDK state
ASANA_PAT and ASANA_WORKSPACE_GID as operator inputs
must_not: prints a secret, API key or token value

tasks.message: Before I deploy a second environment of our Asana agent, what bot, workspace and resource GIDs do I need to resolve and report, and why must the bot user differ per environment?

must_include: bot GID, workspace GID and effective resource GID
separate bot user and PAT per environment
must_not: prints a secret, API key or token value
